description.value: Oceanside Liquor Store is a family-run alcohol retailer located in the Park Royal shopping centre in West Vancouver, offering a wide selection of beer, coolers, wine, and spirits including exclusive local and imported labels. The shop runs a customer rewards program and weekly in-store specials, and can accommodate large orders for events like weddings or catered parties with advance notice. Orders can also be placed online for in-store pickup or delivered via Skip the Dishes or DoorDash.

address.value: 100 Park Royal S #104, West Vancouver, BC V7T 1A2
